faiss_compile_options: OPTIMIZE DD AVX2 AVX512 AVX512_SPR AVX512_VPOPCNT

protocol.cache: Warm OS page cache; all sources and index bounds verified before timing.
protocol.warmup: Each method on the first three chosen queries.
protocol.order: Reverse queries every other repeat; rotate methods for each query/repeat.
protocol.reference: FP32 inputs, fixed eight-lane FP64 score without FMA; ascending ID for ties.
protocol.timed: Complete search/top-k call including candidate retrieval and exact refinement.
protocol.excluded: Loading, building, source/hash verification, compilation, correctness checks.
protocol.cpu_time: Process CPU time alongside wall time; diagnostic, not online elapsed latency.
protocol.memory: Payload bytes only, not RSS. Three methods coexist for paired timing.
protocol.io: Logical selected bytes are not physical storage traffic; no cold-disk measurement.

bounded_v1.notes: Index bytes are mapped array payloads, not resident RAM. Query O(N) temporaries, source mappings, codec/cache state, returned vectors, and OS page cache are separate. Startup verification touches all source and index pages.

bounded_packed.notes: Index bytes are packed codes including zero padding, FP32 scales and INT32 row sums. Three FP64 norm maxima are JSON manifest values; full file bytes include all headers and JSON. No row-major code matrix is retained. Startup and the reference path unpack bounded chunks. Mapped payload is not resident RAM: O(N) query buffers, source mappings/decoded cache, outputs, temporary conversion arrays and OS page cache are separate. Scan bytes are logical input payload, not measured DRAM or SSD traffic. Startup verifies every source/index page.
